issue.title: test_y_then_label_copies_the_links_resolved_path exceeds flake baseline
issue.description: Selection-health flake baseline gate on 2026-09-09 reported tests/pager/test_app_actions.py::test_y_then_label_copies_the_links_resolved_path as the sole reproducible flake above tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt after check-full's test-cost lane passed. Discovered while repairing the main commit-finalizer conflict; the staged diff does not touch tests/pager/test_app_actions.py. Root cause is not known, and no serial reproduction was attempted in this conflict-repair turn.

task_type_fields.evidence: check-full passed lint, validation, committed-plan checks, and test-cost, then failed only selection-health --fail-on-new-flake. The flake-baseline gate reported this node as the single new reproducible flake over the committed baseline. Artifact file:explicit:c7e15c60fb5788e5b25a18b4 captures the full selection-health output.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction from conflict-repair checkout sase_14 on 2026-09-09: after resolving the rebase conflicts, just check-full passed lint, validation, committed plans, and test cost, then failed only selection-health --fail-on-new-flake because tests/pager/test_app_actions.py::test_y_then_label_copies_the_links_resolved_path exceeds tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt.
